text_block_list.text:
I believed in myself, gave it my all... and
took first
place! First place!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I was weak, but I had people who
pushed and
pulled me along until I
finally gave chase. I ran
and ran and
ran...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And now, finally, I'm standing here on
my own!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I can confidently compete with everyone
at the
Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I won't run away anymore. I won't betray

everyone's expectations.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I will shine as the star of the Arima
Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
